The **API** block is in the **API & Third Party** category in the Meridian builder.

Make HTTP or third-party API requests from your flow..

## Settings

### Configure Request

Build method, URL, headers, and body in the request builder.

### Save response to variable

Base name for response variables like {myApi.response.data.id}.
